Why SICAM Q200 power quality recorder?

SICAM Q200 is a power quality recorder and network analyzer for continuous acquisition and assessment of power quality in electrical systems. Insufficient electrical energy quality can cause unplanned downtimes and equipment failures. SICAM Q200 continuously acquires, visualizes, analyzes and transmits AC characteristics like current, voltage, frequency and harmonics to keep your system operational. Identify weak points, implement quality programs, and ensure supply quality to increase equipment service life and reduce downtimes. SICAM Q200 is a PQ device Class A (IEC 62586-1/2, IEC 61000-4-30 Ed. 3), so you can rely on it to deliver accurate values. Comply with EN 50160 and support IEC 61850 and Modbus TCP for interoperability and investment security. Save time and costs through early problem identification.
